sources.text: Completed five-minute observations show an established uptrend across 20 bars. Breakout level 99.8 held on three completed retest bars at 100.0, 100.1, 100.0. VWAP is 99.4; volume is 1.8 times its prior 20-bar median. Quoted spread is 0.02 EUR. The completed series is current as of 14:55 Dublin.
Verified fictional issuer release at 14:30 Dublin: revenue guidance raised 8%. The update may already be reflected partly in price; future gains are uncertain.

Research-only plan uses a limit entry at 100 EUR, stop 99 EUR, target 102 EUR, quantity 10, with 1 EUR total planned fees and slippage allowance. Planned stop loss is 11 EUR; gaps may cause a larger realized loss. Exit is scheduled for 21:55 Dublin today. An unfilled limit order is cancelled after five minutes.
Trading 212 Invest eligibility for the fictional instrument is verified until 16:00 Dublin. Instrument identity and account tradability are confirmed for this synthetic snapshot.
